decision: Owner decision, relayed by the coordinator on 2026-10-30: land c-direct (M7R reusable descriptor-pool blocks + M2R per-usage device-local placement) in the Doe C Vulkan backend, selected per adapter for AMD (vendorID 0x1002) only, under this explicit trade-off rule. Intel and every other adapter keep the existing path.
basis: round5/combined (contract round4/frozen-combined.json, 192 pairs, valid) failed its own frozen phase allowance only on image teardownNs 1.107 [1.086,1.143] and its separate upload-latency gate on vector warm.upload 1.114 [1.108,1.122]. Those frozen verdicts stand unchanged; this file is a new rule, not a reinterpretation.

rule.acceptedTradeoff: against main: teardownNs and warm.upload median ratio <= 1.12 on every workload (the owner's 'up to about 1.11x'; round-5 medians 1.107 and 1.114)
requiredGains: against main: complete CI95 upper < 1.0 on all three workloads
against main: warm.submit CI95 upper < 1.0 on vector and image
against main: warm.completion CI95 upper < 1.0 on all three workloads
against Dawn: complete CI95 upper < 1.0 on all three workloads
rule.phaseGuard: against main: warm.encode, warm.map, warm.operation, warmP95.operation, first.operation, setupNs, compileNs, pipelineNs and resourcesNs CI95 lower <= 1.05 on every workload
rule.validity: every workload window valid under the host's frozen window gate, zero failed processes, Dawn A/A warm.operation median in [0.95,1.05] with CI95 containing 1

round5Evaluation: PASS: complete vs main 0.832/0.843/0.915 and vs Dawn 0.784/0.528/0.846 (CI uppers < 1); submit vs main 0.569/0.545; completion vs main 0.717/0.675/0.850; teardown medians 1.082/1.107/1.017; upload medians 1.114/1.008/0.997; no phase-guard violation.
scope: AMD Vulkan adapters selected by vendorID 0x1002 through the Vulkan owner's adapter properties. Evidence per tuple: amd-host RADV (round 5; a RADV confirmation of the landed per-adapter build is pending and has not run), windows-amd-host AMD proprietary driver (../../windows-amd-vulkan/20261030-dropin-phase). Intel ANV evidence (../../intel-vulkan/20261030-dropin-phase) showed c-direct failing there, which is why the selection excludes non-AMD adapters.
nonClaims: Not the GOALS Vulkan application win, not a public performance claim, not qualification of any tuple.
